note: A goal profile names the checks a declared goal requires. Each check still needs its own declared bindings; a missing one makes the requirement incomplete. Nothing is inferred from task text.

vertical-units.description: A height, depth or elevation-change output made from sources with declared vertical units.

nodata-support.description: An output whose valid cells must follow its sources' declared fill and support rule.

qa-masked.description: An optical output that must exclude cells flagged by a declared QA layer.

scaled-reflectance.description: Surface reflectance decoded once from a declared integer product encoding.

metric-operation.description: A dataset about to be used for a distance, area, length or buffer operation must be in a metric CRS. For measurements already delivered, use metric-values.

slope-from-dem.description: A slope-in-degrees output derived from a declared DEM.

metric-values.description: Vector measurements already delivered (area or length properties, or a buffer), in any CRS.
